description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class SubunitCountPair, which encapsulates a Subunit entity and an integer count, likely used to represent a pairing of a subunit with its associated count within the OrangeHRM dashboard module.

classes.name: SubunitCountPair
classes.description: A DTO class representing a pair consisting of a Subunit entity and an associated integer count.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a SubunitCountPair with a Subunit object and a count.

methods.name: getSubunit
methods.description: Returns the Subunit entity associated with this pair.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the count associated with the Subunit.
